title: Fully Typed Runtime Scanner Operations
scope: PHP AST expression mapping operations on the upstream CLI manifest scanner path
changes: Removed exported free-function declarations from phpAstExpressionMappings.ts.
Introduced PhpAstExpressionMappingOperationsInterface and the frozen phpAstExpressionMappingOperations object.
Introduced PhpAstExpressionClosureOperationsInterface and the frozen phpAstExpressionClosureOperations object.
Migrated scanner and semantic producer call sites to the typed operation object.

Removed generic semantic/relations imports from the PHP AST expression-mapping and closure-traversal boundaries and replaced them with explicit discriminant switches and direct sequence ADT construction.
Preserved domain SemanticDataFlowRelation ADT and empty upstream collections.ts contract.
